name: Nothing Will Remain
source:
Follow the story of a young man named Marius as he finds himself in a terminal chase, running from a crazed, murderous girl, while also seeing fragments of the past that lead him to end up in this situation. Your role as the protagonist is to choose carefully and let Marius live to tell the tale. You'll get to see the world working in mysterious ways.

From [[url=https://vilajur.itch.io/nothingwillremainch1]itch.io[/url]]
